summary: This is a test file that verifies an array length function works correctly. It creates a 5-element array, calls a function that counts its elements, and confirms the result is 5. The actual function uses bash's nameref feature to count array items dynamically.

explanations.8: The 'local -n' creates a nameref (name reference), which makes 'array_length' point to whatever variable name was passed in as $1. So when you pass 'arr', array_length becomes an alias to arr.
explanations.9: The ${#array_length[@]} syntax asks bash for the length (the # symbol) of the array (the [@] means all elements). It's bash's way of getting an array's size.
